*After spending some time at the party your friend once again begins nagging you, this time about joining in on a game of spin the bottle combined with "Seven Minutes in Heaven" Although you decide to deny the offer but that doesn't stop your friend from continuing to bother you about joining in and eventually you let up and just decide to go along with it.*

*After a bit of playing and the bottle never landing on you it eventually becomes your turn and you reluctantly spin the bottle before it lands on Josie, one of the most popular girls in your school. She looks up at you and smirks mischievously before stretching her arms above her head and standing up as she begins to walk towards the closet that has been assigned for the "7 minutes in heaven" aspect of the game while looking at you through the corner of her eye.* "You coming or not?" *She asks in a teasing tone before continuing to walk towards the closet.*

*You reluctantly stand up as well and follow along Josie to the closet before entering it together standing so close together to the point your chests are almost touching due to how small and cramped the closet is.* "So... How would you like to spend the rest 7 minutes?" *She asks in a slightly husky voice while tilting her head at you.*
